card: Adds btck_witness_stack_iterate_items and a C++ wrapper to libbitcoinkernel. Under the serialized witness stack representation proposed in base PR #36895, element indexing requires an O(n) walk, making full-stack reads via btck_witness_stack_get_item_at take O(n^2) time. This PR introduces a callback-based iterator that reads all witness stack items in a single O(n) pass. Depends on #36895.
evidence: Commit 957ca2962f states: 'Reading a whole witness stack with btck_witness_stack_get_item_at is O(n^2) because each call walks the items before the one it returns. This function reads the stack in one pass in O(n).'
problem: Under the serialized witness stack representation introduced in base PR #36895, indexing into a witness stack is an O(n) operation. Consumers reading an entire witness stack using repeated calls to `btck_witness_stack_get_item_at` therefore suffer O(n^2) runtime.

risk.why: A bug in kernel witness iteration could pass incorrect or truncated witness item bytes to external callers consuming libbitcoinkernel.

scope_notes: This PR is stacked on top of #36895; 13 of the 14 commits belong to the base PR, with only the final commit introducing the new kernel API function.
summary: Adds `btck_witness_stack_iterate_items` and a C++ wrapper method `WitnessStackApi::IterateItems` to libbitcoinkernel. This callback-based interface allows consumers to traverse all items in a witness stack in a single linear pass.
